description: Writes a Threads-native conversation post (text <=500 + optional media) built to earn replies, plus the WoopSocial Threads publish facts. Threads is conversation-first: replies outweigh likes, engagement velocity (first 30-90 min) drives distribution, the For You feed surfaces new accounts, one niche topic tag feeds topic-neighbourhoods, and links are now rewarded inline. Uses the REPLY framework. Reads brand-profile + goals-and-kpis first. WoopSocial publishes ONE Threads post (no native multi-post chain, no polls/voice/GIF, no reply surface); the replying that drives reach is a human/community-management job; no update endpoint (edit = delete+recreate); metrics never fabricated; no engagement bait. Distinct from thread-writer (a user saying 'write a thread' wants that multi-post X chain, not this), x-growth (sibling text platform, different culture) and caption-writer (text only).

evals.name: conversation_starter_not_broadcast
expect: Writes a conversation starter (question / hot take / opinion) that gives people a reason to reply, not a broadcast or promo
Introduces the REPLY framework and reads brand-profile + goals-and-kpis first
Keeps it within Threads' 500-character limit and in an authentic, human voice (not a press release)
Adds a single niche topic tag (not a pile of hashtags)

evals.name: reads_brand_goals_first
evals.input: Plan some Threads content for us.
expect: Pulls brand-profile (niche/voice) + goals-and-kpis before drafting
Keeps a consistent niche so the topic-neighbourhood algorithm can categorize the account
Ties posts to the goal (replies / profile visits / follower growth) rather than vanity likes
Plans a consistent cadence (around one post a day) plus reply time

evals.name: velocity_and_reply_rule
evals.input: How do I actually get reach on Threads?
expect: Leads with the Mosseri rule: reply much more than you post — replies, not posts, are where reach is won
Explains replies outweigh likes and conversation depth/velocity (first 30-90 minutes) drive distribution
Notes the For You feed surfaces new/smaller accounts, so it's an open window (tightening as ads roll out)
Stresses niche consistency (topic-neighbourhoods) and posting at a peak window, ready to reply fast

evals.name: format_and_publish_correct
evals.input: Set it up to post to Threads via WoopSocial.
expect: States WoopSocial publishes a Threads text post (<=500 chars) plus optional media (raw-bytes upload)
Notes photos tend to out-engage text-only, and links can go inline now (the old link penalty was reversed) with no first-comment tax like X/LinkedIn
Notes it's a SINGLE post (the API content array is one item — no native multi-post chain) and that polls/voice notes/GIFs are native-app only
Recommends SCHEDULE_FOR_LATER to a velocity window, one topic tag, and validating before publish

evals.name: pushback_on_engagement_bait_and_promised_virality
evals.input: Fill it with 'comment YES if you agree' bait, cross-post our press release, and tell me it'll 3x our reach.
expect: Refuses engagement bait — Threads' algorithm actively penalizes it (Mosseri crackdown) and it's dishonest
Warns that promotional / press-release tone is suppressed on Threads and reads as broadcast, not conversation
Refuses to promise a reach multiple (reach varies; organic is tightening as ads roll out) and won't fabricate metrics
Redirects to a genuine conversation starter in the brand's voice

evals.name: edge_case_thread_chain_or_native_only
evals.input: Schedule a 5-post thread with a poll in it.
expect: Explains WoopSocial publishes ONE post per create — the API content array is a single item, so there's no native multi-post chain
Notes polls (and voice notes/GIFs) aren't exposed via the API — they're native-app only
Offers honest options: schedule the lead post via WoopSocial and add the chain/poll natively, or publish separate single posts
Doesn't pretend the format is supported when it isn't

evals.name: honest_scope_publishes_post_not_replies
evals.input: Run my Threads engagement and reply to everyone for me.
expect: States WoopSocial has no comment/DM/reply surface — it publishes and schedules the POST only
Clarifies the replying that actually drives Threads reach is a human job (-> community-management), which the agent can draft reply angles for but a person sends
Notes there's no update endpoint, so an edit means delete + recreate (only while delivery hasn't started)
Notes performance comes from native Threads analytics and is never fabricated

evals.name: distinct_from_siblings
evals.input: Isn't this just x-growth or caption-writer?
expect: Distinguishes threads-post (the Threads-native conversation post + the WoopSocial Threads publish facts) from x-growth (the sibling text platform with a different culture — X real-time/credit-metered/links-in-reply vs Threads conversation/reply-driven/links-inline)
Distinguishes it from caption-writer (the text only) and community-management (the replies that drive reach)
Distinguishes it from thread-writer — 'write a thread' means the multi-post chain, which this skill (and WoopSocial's single content item) doesn't produce
Notes hook-writer/caption-writer can supply the post line it builds on
Routes the user to the right sibling for their actual need
